svg.title: Reference architecture: four stages, two seams
svg.desc: A left-to-right pipeline: a synthetic source system generated from a DBML model, extracted by dlt into a DuckDB warehouse file, transformed by dbt into staging, intermediate and mart layers, rendered by Evidence into a static report and published to GitHub Pages. Two dashed seams either side of dlt mark the only two points that change when the stack is pointed at a production database or a cloud warehouse.
